label: Chapter kicker with step dots
description: A table of contents on screen for a chaptered walkthrough (the founder-bookends-chapters recipe): a small kicker names the current step bottom-left ('Test scenarios with users') and a row of step dots sits bottom-right, one per chapter, the current one filled. Cast ONE per chapter scene with the same `steps` and a rising `step`; it fades in at `at` and holds to the cut. Full-frame overlay -- it places itself. Ink is dark for a white ground (default) or light for a dark one. Example: {"text":"Define what good means","step":2,"steps":3,"at":0.3}.

text.label: The chapter's name, three to five words

steps.label: How many chapters in the walkthrough

ink.label: dark (default, for a white ground) | light

side.label: Kicker side; the dots take the other (default left)
